EXAMPLE PAVING COMPANY
600 Asphalt Way, Exampletown, CA 90004   License No. 900003 Class A, C-12
PROPOSAL 26-1174
Bill To: Example Community Association c/o Sample Management
Job: Parking lot crack seal, seal coat, and striping

Scope
1. Crack seal all cracks over 1/4 inch.
2. Apply two coats of seal coat to the parking lot.
3. Restripe all stalls and the fire lane to match the existing layout.
The price includes all labor, materials, and equipment. Traffic control is included at no additional cost.
Example Paving Company will notify the Customer at least forty-eight (48) hours before the work begins.
Extra Work. Owner agrees to pay Example Paving Company for any extra work requested by Owner at the rates in Schedule A.
Payment. Owner shall pay fifty percent (50%) upon acceptance and the balance upon completion.
Warranty. Example Paving Company warrants its workmanship for one (1) year from completion.
Exclusions: permits, engineering, and repairs to the base.
Attorney's Fees. In any action to enforce this proposal, the prevailing party shall recover its reasonable attorney's fees.
